## Summary
Sidekix 0.4.1 expands the instrument library with two opt-in modules: Mac Engine Room for live CPU, memory, and network activity, and Power Dock for Mac and accessory battery levels. It also refines instrument editing, panel behavior, Buddy interactions, and daily-instrument presentation while preserving existing layouts and settings.
## Changes
- **feat**: Add Mac Engine Room with live mechanical system-activity gauges. - **feat**: Add Power Dock for Mac and connected accessory battery status. - **improve**: Refine instrument editing, drawer controls, onboarding, and detail-panel behavior. - **improve**: Polish Buddy, Water, Focus, and Lofi Radio interactions and presentation. - **docs**: Document the production packaging, Sparkle signing, and appcast publishing workflow.
## Commits
6908ca0 release: bump version to 0.4.1 including Engine Room and Power Dock
Sidekix 0.4.0 introduces Buddy, a small focus companion, and refreshes the panel and onboarding experience.
Sidekix 0.3.1 adds secure automatic updates through Sparkle, restores the Window widget after reopening the panel, and automatically plays newly selected scenes and videos with a loading overlay.
